name: LibHoughTransform
summary: This is an MQL5 library implementing the Linear Hough Transform, a computer vision algorithm used to detect straight lines in 2D images. It provides a factory function to create Hough transform objects and extracts line parameters (slope and intercept) from binary image data. The code is a general-purpose signal processing utility, not a trading EA.
summary_zh: 这是一个MQL5库文件，实现了线性霍夫变换（Hough Transform），一种用于在二维图像中检测直线的计算机视觉算法。它提供工厂函数创建霍夫变换对象，并从二值图像数据中提取直线参数（斜率和截距）。该代码是通用信号处理工具，并非交易EA。
strategy_analysis: 此代码并非交易策略，而是一个霍夫变换的数学库实现。它通过将图像空间中的像素映射到参数空间（rho-theta空间）来检测直线，每个非零像素对所有可能的theta角度投票，累积到二维累加器数组中。提取阶段通过寻找累加器中的局部最大值来识别最显著的直线，并使用非极大值抑制（清除峰值周围3x3邻域）来避免重复检测。最终将每条检测到的直线转换为y=a*x+b的斜截式参数输出。该库支持int和double两种数据类型，通过模板类实现类型泛化。然而，代码中完全没有交易逻辑、入场/出场条件、仓位管理或资金管理策略。
strategy_analysis_en: This code is not a trading strategy but rather a mathematical library implementation of the Hough Transform. It maps pixels from image space into parameter space (rho-theta space) to detect straight lines, where each non-zero pixel votes for all possible theta angles, accumulating into a 2D accumulator array. The extraction phase identifies the most prominent lines by finding local maxima in the accumulator, using non-maximum suppression (clearing a 3x3 neighborhood around each peak) to prevent duplicate detections. Each detected line is ultimately converted to slope-intercept form y=a*x+b as output parameters. The library supports both int and double data types through template class genericity. However, the code contains absolutely no trading logic, entry/exit conditions, position sizing, or money management strategy whatsoever.

pros: 模板化设计支持多种数据类型，具有良好的代码复用性
实现了非极大值抑制机制，避免重复检测同一条直线
将直线参数转换为直观的斜截式(y=ax+b)，便于下游使用
工厂模式创建对象，支持未来扩展更多变换类型
预计算三角函数表，避免重复计算，提升性能
pros_en: Template-based design supports multiple data types with good code reusability
Implements non-maximum suppression to avoid duplicate detection of the same line
Converts line parameters to intuitive slope-intercept form (y=ax+b) for downstream use
Factory pattern for object creation, supporting future extension of more transform types
Pre-computed trigonometric table avoids repeated calculations and improves performance
cons: findMax中的非极大值抑制仅清除3x3邻域，对于高分辨率累加器可能不够充分
缺少对输入图像有效性检查（如空图像或零尺寸图像的处理）
角度分辨率固定为M_PI/size，无法根据图像特征自适应调整
没有提供反向变换或验证功能来确认检测结果的可靠性
当sin(t)接近零时参数转换可能产生数值不稳定
cons_en: Non-maximum suppression in findMax only clears a 3x3 neighborhood, which may be insufficient for high-resolution accumulators
Lacks input image validity checks (e.g., handling of empty or zero-sized images)
Angular resolution is fixed at M_PI/size with no adaptive adjustment based on image characteristics
No inverse transform or verification functionality to confirm detection reliability
Parameter conversion may produce numerical instability when sin(t) approaches zero
improvements: 增加自适应非极大值抑制窗口大小，根据累加器分辨率动态调整
添加输入数据验证和边界检查，提高库的鲁棒性
增加对sin(t)接近零时的数值稳定性处理，防止除零或极大值
improvements_en: Add adaptive non-maximum suppression window size that dynamically adjusts based on accumulator resolution
Add input data validation and boundary checks to improve library robustness
Add numerical stability handling when sin(t) approaches zero to prevent division by zero or extreme values

risk_points: 此为纯数学库，不涉及交易操作，无交易风险
数值稳定性问题仅在特定输入条件下可能出现
risk_points_en: This is a pure mathematical library with no trading operations and no trading risk
Numerical stability issues may only appear under specific input conditions
